concept: Parallel Agent Management & Interface Contract Boundaries
merge_problem: When multiple agents modify shared schema or state boundaries concurrently without synchronization, isolated code correctness produces integration failure.

parallelizable_tasks: Task Stream A: Team Invitations & RBAC Membership endpoints (touches invitations, memberships stores)
Task Stream B: Real-Time Activity Feed & Audit Logger (touches activityFeed service and events bus)
strictly_sequential_tasks: Task 1 (Team Entity Model) MUST precede Task 2 (Team Route Controllers)
Task 3 (Membership Schema) MUST precede Task 4 (RBAC Permission Middleware)
micro_exercise.dependency_graph_summary: Foundation (Team Model & Store) -> Fan-out: [Stream A: Invitations/RBAC] || [Stream B: Activity/Audit] -> Fan-in: Integration Gateway & Contract Verification

construction_analogy: Running electrical wiring and plumbing crews without a shared blueprint: both work fast and correctly in isolation, but collide when claiming the same physical bulkhead. Interface contracts provide the immutable shared blueprint.
